question: A car covers a distance of 30 km and 250 metres in 25 minutes. The speed of the car in km per hour is _____.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance covered = 30.25 km.

Total time taken = 25 minutes = 25/60 hours.

Speed = Distance × (Inverse of Time)

Speed = 30.25 × (60/25) = 1.21 × 60 = 72.6 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 72.6 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

→ Distance covered = 30 km 250 m = 30.25 km

→ Time taken = 25 minutes = 25/60 hours = 5/12 hours

**Formula Used:**

→ Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed = 30.25 ÷ (5/12)

⇒ Speed = 30.25 × (12/5)

⇒ Speed = 6.05 × 12

⇒ Speed = 72.6 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 72.6 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversions for Speed

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18. To convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed

If equal distances are covered at speeds x and y, Average Speed = (2xy) ÷ (x + y). For variable distances, Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Relative Speed

For two objects moving in the same direction, Relative Speed = S₁ − S₂. For objects moving in opposite directions, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂.
